headline: President Prabowo Attends NasDem Party 15th Anniversary Event
metaDescription: President Prabowo Subianto participated in the 15th anniversary celebration of the NasDem Party, held at the party's headquarters in Jakarta today.
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto attended the 15th anniversary event of the NasDem Party in Jakarta.
The event was hosted by NasDem Party chairman Surya Paloh and attended by various political figures.
Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka was not present at the anniversary celebration.
aiContextParagraph: The NasDem Party recently celebrated its 15th anniversary with a commemorative event held at its central leadership office in Jakarta. The celebration, themed 'Meneguhkan Restorasi, Menguatkan Bakti', saw the attendance of President Prabowo Subianto, who was received by the party's chairman, Surya Paloh. The event brought together numerous political leaders to mark the milestone. During the proceedings, Surya Paloh addressed party members, emphasizing the need for continued solidarity and militancy among cadres as they look toward future political cycles, specifically the 2029 general election. While several ministers and political officials were present to accompany the President, reports noted that Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka did not attend the function. The gathering served as a platform for NasDem to reinforce its organizational cohesion and political messaging.
whyItIsViral: The event gained significant traction due to the high-profile attendance of the President and the notable absence of the Vice President, triggering rapid coverage across major Indonesian news outlets.
